Creamy garlic pasta 🍝✨

Ingredients 👇
▪️ 250g spaghetti
▪️ 4 cloves garlic, minced
▪️ 1/2 cup double cream
▪️ 1/4 cup grated parmesan
▪️ 2 tbsp butter

How to:
1️⃣ Cook the spaghetti until al dente.
2️⃣ Melt the butter and soften the garlic for 1 minute.
3️⃣ Stir in the cream and parmesan.
4️⃣ Toss the pasta through the sauce.
